== Notes ==
* The foe must successfully activate a skill for Wastrel's Worry to end early. An [[interrupt]]ed/[[cancel]]ed skill does not count.
* The description is somewhat misleading; if Wastrel's Worry ends early for ''any'' reason, the foe does not take damage.
* Casting Wastrel's Worry on a foe already hexed with it has no effect.
* The hex is especially effective on foes that do not use skills (e.g. [[minion]]s and [[pet]]s) and those with active hex reduction (e.g. most bosses, [[Natural Resistance]]).
* Wastrel's Worry is also useful to force targets to choose how they take damage — from (a) failure to use a skill (this hex) or by using a skill (e.g. [[Visions of Regret]], [[Empathy]], [[Backfire]]).
* Heroes preferentially use this on [[caster]]s.
